# IndieWire

> > IndieWire is a leading film and television industry publication covering awards season, festivals, independent cinema, visual effects, and entertainment business news.

IndieWire provides comprehensive coverage of the film and television industry, from major awards ceremonies like the Oscars, SAG, and César Awards to film festivals including Sundance, SXSW, and Cannes. The publication features exclusive interviews, reviews, predictions from critics like Anne Thompson, and industry analysis through its Studio interview series and Filmmaker Toolkit podcast.

## Key Topics

- Awards Season & Oscar Predictions
- Sundance Film Festival
- SXSW
- Visual Effects & VFX
- Avatar: Fire and Ash
- Independent Cinema
- Film Festivals
- IndieWire Studio Interviews
- César Awards
- SAG Awards
- Filmmaker Toolkit
- Industry Business News
- Film Reviews & Criticism
- Entertainment Journalism
- Cannes Film Festival
